unresolved_components.title: Claim CFPB was legally disbanded and all pending enforcement actions were dropped
unresolved_components.reason: Sources describe February work stoppages and staffing reductions, March partial resumption of legally required functions, and an April court-halted mass-layoff attempt; they do not establish legal dissolution or termination of every matter.
unresolved_components.missing_evidence: An authoritative dissolution action and a complete sourced accounting of pending enforcement matters and their dispositions.

rationale: The supplied evidence supports distinct chronological developments but not the claim that the CFPB ceased to exist or dropped every matter. No children are emitted pending validated event-specific drafts.
